title: Finite modules descend from an element localization
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $f\in R$, and let $R_f$ be the localization of $R$ at $f$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. Let $L$ be a finitely generated $R_f$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then there are a finitely generated $R$-module $M$ and an isomorphism of $R_f$-modules $M_f\cong L$, where $M_f$ is the localization of $M$ at the multiplicative set $\{1,f,f^2,\dots\}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization].
